mapper.sql: id, delivery_box_id, specification_id, location_id, number, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted
mapper.update: update sto_yt_delivery_box_item set is_deleted=1 where delivery_box_id = #{id}
update sto_yt_delivery_box_item set is_deleted=1 where delivery_box_id in(select id from sto_yt_delivery_box where delivery_id = #{id})
mapper.select: SELECT sum(sydbi.number) as number, sydbi.specification_id, pyp.code as productCode, pyp.id as product_id, sydbi.category_specification_item_id, sydbi.category_specification_item_name, (select name from sto_yt_location where id= sydbi.location_id) as locationName, syo.code as orderNo FROM sto_yt_delivery_box_item as sydbi left join pro_yt_product_specification as pyps on sydbi.specification_id = pyps.id left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = pyps.product_id left join sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi on syosi.id = sydbi.order_item_id left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id WHERE sydbi.delivery_box_id = #{deliveryBoxId} AND sydbi.is_deleted = 0 group by sydbi.specification_id, sydbi.category_specification_item_id, sydbi.location_id, sydbi.category_specification_item_name, syo.id ORDER BY max(sydbi.create_time)

SELECT sydbi.*, pyp.code as productCode, pyp.id as product_id, (select name from sto_yt_location where id= sydbi.location_id) as locationName, sydbi.category_specification_item_id as categorySpecificationItemId, sydbi.category_specification_item_name as categorySpecificationItemName FROM sto_yt_delivery_box_item as sydbi left join pro_yt_product_specification as pyps on sydbi.specification_id = pyps.id left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = pyps.product_id left join sto_yt_delivery_box as sydb on sydb.id = sydbi.delivery_box_id left join sto_yt_delivery as syd on syd.id = sydb.delivery_id WHERE syd.id = #{deliveryId} AND sydbi.is_deleted = 0

SELECT sum(sydbi.number) as number -- pyp.code as productCode, -- pyp.id as product_id, -- (select name from sto_yt_location where id= sydbi.location_id) as locationName, -- syos.order_id as orderId, -- syos.id as orderSubId, -- syosi.order_sub_item_id as orderSubItemId, -- syosi.category_specification_item_id as categorySpecificationItemId, -- syosi.category_specification_item_name as categorySpecificationItemName FROM sto_yt_delivery_box_item as sydbi left join pro_yt_product_specification as pyps on sydbi.specification_id = pyps.id left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = pyps.product_id left join sto_yt_delivery_box as sydb on sydb.id = sydbi.delivery_box_id left join sto_yt_delivery as syd on syd.id = sydb.delivery_id left join sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi on syosi.id = sydbi.order_item_id left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id WHERE syd.id = #{deliveryId} AND syos.order_id = #{orderId} AND sydbi.is_deleted = 0 AND syosi.is_deleted = 0 group by sydbi.specification_id,sydbi.category_specification_item_id,sydbi.location_id,sydbi.category_specification_item_name

SELECT DISTINCT syos.order_id FROM sto_yt_delivery_box_item AS sydbi LEFT JOIN sto_yt_delivery_box AS sydb ON sydb.id = sydbi.delivery_box_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub_item AS syosi ON syosi.id = sydbi.order_item_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub AS syos ON syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id WHERE sydb.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND sydbi.is_deleted = 0 AND syosi.is_deleted = 0
